falsification_conditions.condition: The asset price drops by 10% from current levels within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp decline would contradict the breakout pattern's upward momentum, invalidating the UNKNOWN verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume falls below 30% of the 20-day average during the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Low volume would indicate lack of participation, refuting the blowoff score's implication of high volatility.

falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 closes above 5,200 (a key resistance level) within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Breaking above this level would confirm a bullish trend, directly contradicting the HOLD signal's indecision.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
